title: 第一卷 第19章 敬酒不吃吃罚酒第一卷 第20章 年轻人不要太气盛
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
呼~
户曹大人吹走茶盏中的浮沫，饮下一口热茶，望向面前的李毅。
“不错不错，没想到黑石镇还有你这个可造之材，一进军营就立下这么大功劳，还破格提前进入了弓兵队，不错不错。”
户曹这话，让李毅心中一惊讶，同时也对户曹多了几分杀意。
这明摆着就是告诉自己，他户曹在看着自己的一举一动，自己时刻都在他的注视下。
一股寒意，从李毅心中冒起。
连在军营的自己都被其盯着，那留在家中的弟弟妹妹几人呢？
他们还安全吗？
一时间，李毅心中焦急不已。
不对，他肯定不能确定就是我杀死的王大贵，不然不可能对我这么客气。
我要稳住！
思绪纷飞间，李毅心神大定。
“都是户曹大人治理有功，军中主官赏识，才能让我有了进步的机会。”
李毅不卑不亢道。
听着这话，户曹却是露出了感兴趣的神色。
“哦？那我这里有一个进步的机会，你要不要？”
户曹望向站在李毅身后的几个衙役，笑道：
“我看你为人机警，不如来我麾下，当一个衙役怎么样？”
“这可比当大头兵，去前线送死好多了。”
“多谢大人抬爱，只是我刚进军营，这徭役尚未服完，等以后有机会再为大人效力。”

来户曹麾下，那不就是羊入虎口，主动进了狼窝？
李毅果断拒绝了户曹的招揽。
闻言，户曹确实哈哈一笑，将手中的茶盏放在了紫檀木茶几上。
“这徭役，不就是我一句话的事嘛。”
“我说你服完了，你就是服完了，谁会有意见？”
“至于这军营里，我也有一点点薄面，将你运作出来，也不过是我一句话的事。”
绝对不能去户曹麾下！
在军中虽然危险，但是有大把机会变强。
若是去这户曹麾下，就算是不会被其发现自己是杀死王大贵的凶手，那也不可。
那王大贵即使本性恶劣，但是其很多坏事，也是受了户曹的指使才做出来的。
如果投靠户曹当了衙役在，指定要被其安排，去做那些鱼肉乡民的恶事。
能独自坚守武馆十几年，李毅心中自有一股傲气。
他可以为了活下去不择手段，但是绝不会去当一个欺行霸市的恶人。
李毅微微低头，正在斟酌措辞，准备回绝户曹。
端坐一旁的户曹，见李毅迟迟不表态，不由得冷哼一声。
“王大贵是不是死在你手上，我不在乎，只不过一条随意驱使的恶狗罢了。”
“但是他死了就死了，我的事可不能耽搁。”
“你既然有本事解决他，那应该也能解决我的烦恼，替我解决那些王大贵没有解决的事情吧？”
“况且你弟弟大病初愈，正是需要进补的时候，可不要影响到他的根子骨！”
户曹的话，宛如平地起惊雷，瞬间让李毅神色大震，猛然抬头望向户曹。

弄死王大贵这事，可谓是天衣无缝，即使是狄仁杰再世，也抓不到李毅的把柄。
但是他没想到，这陈国竟然糟糕到了这个程度。
content_en:
Phew~
Mr. Hucao blew away the foam in the tea cup, took a sip of hot tea, and looked at Li Yi in front of him.
"Not bad, not bad. I didn't expect that Blackstone Town would still have a talent like you. You made such a great contribution as soon as you entered the military camp, and you even joined the archers in advance. Not bad, not bad."
Hu Cao's words surprised Li Yi, and at the same time he also had a bit more murderous intention towards Hu Cao.
This was clearly telling him that Hu Cao was watching his every move, and that he was always under his watch.
A chill came from Li Yi's heart.
Even he was watching me in the military camp, but how many younger brothers and sisters were left at home?
Are they still safe?
For a moment, Li Yi was anxious.
No, he definitely couldn't be sure that it was Wang Dagui who I killed, otherwise he wouldn't be so polite to me.
I need to hold on!
While his thoughts were swirling, Li Yi felt calm.
"It's because Master Hu Cao has made great achievements in governance and is appreciated by the chief military officer that I have the opportunity to progress."
Li Yi said neither humble nor arrogantly.
Hearing this, Hu Cao showed an interested expression.
"Oh? Then I have a chance to make progress here, do you want it?"
Hu Cao looked at the government servants standing behind Li Yi and said with a smile:
"I think you are a smart person, why don't you come under my command and become a yamen servant?"
"This is much better than being a top soldier and going to the front line to die."
"Thank you for your kindness, sir. It's just that I have just entered the military camp and have not finished my service yet. I will serve you again when I have the opportunity in the future."
Coming under Cao Hu's command, isn't that like a sheep entering the tiger's mouth and taking the initiative to enter the wolf's den?
Li Yi decisively rejected Hu Cao's solicitation.
Hearing this, Hu Cao actually laughed and placed the tea cup in his hand on the rosewood coffee table.
"Isn't this corvée a matter of just a word from me?"
"I said you've served your time, and you've served your time. Who will have any objections?"
"As for this military camp, I also have a little bit of a weak point. It's just a matter of my words to make you work."
You absolutely can’t go under Hu Cao’s command!
Although being in the military is dangerous, there are plenty of opportunities to become stronger.
If he goes under Cao's command, even if he doesn't find out that he is the murderer of Wang Dagui, that's not possible.
Even though Wang Dagui had a bad nature, many of his bad deeds were caused by Hu Cao's instructions.
If you take refuge with Hucao and become a yamen servant, you will be assigned to do evil things like those of the villagers.
Being able to stick to the martial arts gym alone for more than ten years, Li Yi has a sense of pride in his heart.
He will do whatever it takes to survive, but he will never become a villain who bullies and dominates the market.
Li Yi lowered his head slightly and was considering his words, preparing to reject Hu Cao.
Hu Cao, who was sitting aside, couldn't help but snorted coldly when he saw Li Yi's delay in expressing his position.
"I don't care if Wang Dagui dies in your hands, he's just a vicious dog driven at will."
"But if he dies, he dies. I can't delay my affairs."
"Since you have the ability to solve him, you should also be able to solve my troubles and solve the things that Wang Dagui has not solved for me, right?"
"Besides, your brother has just recovered from a serious illness. This is the time when he needs to take supplements. Don't affect his bones!"
Hu Cao's words were like thunder on the ground. Li Yi was shocked in an instant and suddenly raised his head to look at Hu Cao.
The matter of killing Wang Dagui was so seamless that even if Di Renjie was reincarnated, he would not be able to catch Li Yi.
But he didn't expect that Chen Guo would be so bad.
